caption:
April in Sayulita is when everything outside comes alive.

The dry season is at its peak. Water is calm. The light is gold from about 4pm on. Every reason you come here is doing its best work right now — here's what to actually do with your days:

🏄 Surf. The breaks at Playa Los Muertos and La Lancha are running steady and friendly this month — ideal for first-timers, still fun for intermediates. Local instructors will have you up by day two.

🐋 Humpback whales. They're on their tail end of the season, heading north. A morning boat out toward the Marietas Islands will almost always turn up a tail slap or a breach.

🏝️ Marietas Islands day trip. The hidden beach inside the crater is bucket-list for a reason. Snorkeling in the surrounding reefs is some of the best on the Pacific coast.

🧘 Sunrise yoga on the beach. Before the heat of the day. Paloma Blanca or right on the sand in front of town.

🥾 Hike Monkey Mountain. Early morning, 90 minutes up, views all the way to San Pancho and Punta Mita.

🌮 Friday mercado. Local producers, handmade everything, best mezcal tastings of the week. Then dinner at Don Pedro's with your feet in the sand.

🎨 Wander Sayulita's streets. Colorful papel picado overhead, local art, surf shops, the kind of town you plan a trip back to before you've even left.

🌅 Sunset at La Lancha. Drive 15 minutes, walk through the jungle, come out on an almost-empty beach with a perfect horizon.

This is the month for all of it. Come see.
